text: Photography is an art form that captures reality through the use of light and camera. Initially, photographers experimented with different angles and positions to control how the subject was perceived. The first camera emerged in the early 1800s, and with it, the understanding of lighting became crucial. Lighting sets the mood and tone, and early photographers mastered the ability to control it to evoke the desired effect. As technology advanced, tripods became essential equipment, allowing photographers to steady their cameras and ensure consistent and controlled lighting, whether photographing a still subject or a moving scene. Today, photographers continue to study and manipulate lighting to enhance their images, making photography an ever-evolving art.
